happy 19th birthday, julie,

i wanted to write this because i can’t be there with you today, and i hate that more than i can say. but i didn’t want the day to pass without you holding something from me, something you can read whenever you need a reminder of how loved you are.

i know birthdays haven’t always been kind to you. i know you think yours are the worst, and today you’re busy with school and missing the celebration you deserve. i won’t pretend that doesn’t matter. it’s okay to feel sad or lonely today. but i hope you’ll let me show you another side of this day.

your birthday is the day the world got you. you are the most hardworking person i know, julie. you keep going even when you’re exhausted, you care so much about everything you do, and you do it all while still being the silliest, cutest girl i have ever met. nobody makes me laugh the way you do. nobody makes an ordinary day feel as bright as you do.

being busy with school today doesn’t mean you’re missing out. it means you’re building your future one day at a time, and i see every bit of effort you put in. you are doing better than you think, and i am so proud of you.

i’m sorry the distance keeps me from hugging you today. but distance has never made my love smaller. if anything, it has shown me how strong we are. every call and every message across the miles tells me you are worth every bit of the wait. and one day, i hope we won’t have to celebrate apart anymore. i dream about making you my wife someday, and when that day comes, every birthday of yours will be loud, silly, and full of cake. i promise.

until then, please be gentle with yourself today. eat something sweet, drink something you love, and let yourself smile, even if it’s a small one. you deserve that, and so much more.

you are loved, you are enough, and you are so special to me. i hope this year brings you peace, joy, and everything you’ve been working so hard for. and i hope that by the end of it, you look back and call this the year your birthdays finally started to feel good.

happy birthday, my love. i’m with you today, and always.

with all my love,
vince

little note:
i'm dedicating this song to you from an artist that i followed ever since i was a teenager, and also before that artist even became an artist. with the reason being that it is one of the deepest songs i know, and that i consider it the highest form of romantic song i could ever dedicate to you.

us ♡
